SOURCE VERIFICATION

Printed rules and errata remain distinct

Draconis Reach pp. 167–175 are the authoritative track text for this browser. The supplied Hot Spots Hinterlands v2.41 errata was reviewed directly. Its track-specific changes target the older Hinterlands page numbers and are not merged into the Draconis Reach records.
